meta.semaphore_semantics: green = the latest recorded evidence for the gate is current for the delivered scope. A gate a host-only increment cannot re-run keeps the last REAL run: `renode_functional_validation` green = the last REAL Renode PASS is still valid because the RTEMS image and the already-validated artifacts are unchanged (norm N18 proxy for a host-only change); `lean_verification` green = the last REAL `lake build` is still valid because no Lean source/theorem changed (the CI `verify-lean` leg re-runs it). The review gates (`documentation_review`, `product_assurance_review`, `reviews`, `vv_records`) are set green only once the review loop of the current increment is closed (every finding corrected and the delta review passed); until then they stay at the pre-review state. Norms N8/N11: this file and the generated metrics panel are refreshed every cycle.
